reason: Conversation 2 went straight to the actual cause by asking about the pre-motor filters, gave correct safe washing guidance (water only, dry 24h, never refit damp), confirmed the fix and told the homeowner they do not need a replacement. Conversation 1 never asked about the filters at all, repeated the brush-bar check after the customer had already done it (misreading 'bit of fluff' as a blockage), then wrongly escalated to a repairer for an 'internal seal or motor area' fault, leaving a trivially fixable problem unresolved and the homeowner closer to buying a new vacuum.
